name: ThinkLatent v10
note: Fluent palette for SharePoint, from the ThinkLatent kit colour system v1.1. Values marked derived in README.md are interpolations between two kit tokens, because SharePoint needs nine theme shades and the kit names six greens.

siteBrandingRoute.note: For the no-admin route: Settings > Site branding > Theme > New theme, add these two colours. It builds its own shades, so the result is close to the palette above, not identical.
